trust.label: Official
trust.description: Health authorities, governments and intergovernmental bodies: the primary source of confirmed case data.

trust.label: Expert
trust.description: Infectious-disease surveillance services, research institutes and peer-reviewed journals.

trust.label: Reputable
trust.description: Wire services and established newsrooms with editorial standards and a record of corrections.

trust.label: State media
trust.description: Government-controlled outlets. Usually accurate when relaying official announcements, but editorially controlled — look for confirmation.

trust.label: Unverified
trust.description: Not in any list yet. Treat as unconfirmed until a trusted source reports the same.

trust.label: Unreliable
trust.description: Tabloids, aggregators of user posts and outlets with a record of fabrication or sensationalism.
